# Wright Smiles

> Wright Smiles is a family-friendly dental practice in Southlake, TX offering comprehensive cosmetic, restorative, and preventive dental care led by AACD-accredited dentists.

Wright Smiles serves the Southlake, TX area and surrounding communities with a team of experienced dentists including Dr. Gregory Wright, Dr. Victoria Heron, and Dr. Paola Arcila. The practice specializes in cosmetic dentistry, family care, and specialized treatments like sleep apnea and bruxism management.

- [Dental Services](https://wrightsmiles.com/dental-services): Comprehensive dental services: cosmetic, restorative, family care
